description: Ministry of Defence - Award of Sri Lanka Armed Services Long Service Medal to the Personnel
categorisation: This gazette notification announces the award of the Sri Lanka Armed Services Long Service Medal to military personnel. This falls under public service matters as it concerns service recognition and awards for public sector employees (specifically armed forces personnel), which aligns with Type 8 (Public Service Gazettes) that covers public sector service conditions, benefits, and recognitions. While it mentions the President's approval and the Defense Secretary, the core content is about service awards rather than government structural changes or personnel appointments.
